Global Shares Recover Amid AI Rebound, Nvidia Slides

Global stock markets saw a recovery, driven by a rebound in artificial intelligence (AI) related stocks. However, Nvidia experienced a slide in its share price ahead of the US market opening. This volatility in Nvidia has prompted a re-evaluation of the valuations of AI-focused shares in Japan.
